references.text: Concerns opening one's mouth with a vow to the Lord and the obligation to keep it
Emphasizes the importance of keeping vows made to the Lord
Warns about being careful with vows to God and the importance of fulfilling them
Jephthah's original vow that his daughter now responds to
Jacob makes a vow to the Lord, an example of vow-making in the Old Testament
Hannah's vow to the Lord concerning her child, parallel to parents' vows about their children
The Lord's victory over the Ammonites that the daughter refers to
